description: This file defines a custom log consistency provider for Orleans, enabling grain state management via custom storage logic. It includes the implementation of the provider class and a factory for creating instances based on configuration options.

classes.name: LogConsistencyProvider
classes.description: Implements a log-consistency provider that interacts with custom storage, supporting configuration for primary cluster access.
